title: DHIS2 Relationship Viewer
description: A composable React 18 Relationship Viewer block that draws the relationship graph around DHIS2 tracker records.
docs: Render RelationshipViewer beneath the DHIS2 app-runtime and TanStack Query providers. The minimal composition is RelationshipViewer with RelationshipViewerCanvas, RelationshipViewerLegend, RelationshipViewerSummary, RelationshipViewerNotices and RelationshipViewerList as children.
